run_make_lmdb_sizes: run the script to generate metadata.npz files for load balancing a DataLoader from an LMDB dataset
run_get_data: run the get_data function to extract natoms and neighbor counts from a dataset entry by index
run_make_lmdb_sizes_cli: run the CLI with --data-path and --num-workers args to generate metadata for an LMDB dataset
run_get_lmdb_sizes_parser: run get_lmdb_sizes_parser to create an argparse parser with data-path and num-workers arguments
review_make_lmdb_sizes: review the make_lmdb_sizes function that uses multiprocessing to extract atom counts and neighbor data from LMDB datasets
